description: Complete the Campaign: finish Acts 1-4 and the Interludes and reach The Ziggurat Refuge.
Complete Act N: reach the first zone of the next act.
Defeat Pinnacle Bosses: defeat 'pinnacle_bosses_required' endgame pinnacle bosses.
Which class you play. You start with that class unlocked (shown as 'Class - <name>' in the client).
Only this class's ascendancies are placed in the item pool.
Start with your class's weapon type unlocked at Normal rarity, plus your Life and Mana flask slots,
so the opening zones are playable before your first items arrive.

starting_skill_gem.description: Start with one random tier 1 skill gem that fits your class's starting weapon or spell type.

description: Adds your class's ascendancies ('Ascendancy - <name>') and 4 'Progressive Ascendancy Trial' items.
You may only ascend into an ascendancy you received, and each trial item allows 2 ascendancy points.
Off: one '<Name> Support' item unlocks every level of that support lineage (e.g. Barbs I, II and III).
On: each copy received unlocks the next level of the lineage (more items, slower unlocks).
How many 'Passive Skill Point' items are shuffled. You may only allocate as many passive points as you received.
0 turns this off: you can then allocate passives normally. The full game has 123 regular passive points.

add_base_item_locations.description: Picking up each weapon/armour/jewellery/flask/charm base type for the first time is a check.

add_zone_locations.description: Entering each campaign zone for the first time is a check.

add_boss_locations.description: Defeating each zone's campaign boss (and completing the ascendancy trials) is a check.

add_level_locations.description: Reaching each character level is a check.

max_level_location.description: The highest 'Reach Level N' check. Levels past your goal's content are removed automatically.

description: Only used with the 'Defeat Pinnacle Bosses' goal: how many of the 10 pinnacle boss checks you must complete.
Each pinnacle boss check always rewards a 'Pinnacle Boss Trophy'.
